trigger: Route-B audit found that copied digest assertions, post-dict duplicate checks, and uncaught empty-consensus failures can create checks that cannot fail.
scope: Synthetic stress-twin integrity and mutation coverage only; does not alter real Route-A/Route-B scientific outputs.

fragment_digest.rule: Qualification must recompute SHA-256 from actual compressed fragment bytes in an independent consumer. Equality between two copied receipt fields is not evidence of byte linkage.
fragment_digest.mutation: A same-length gzip with a changed MTIME byte but byte-identical decompressed records must fail digest qualification.

fragment_count_linkage.rule: Per-barcode fragment multiplicity must be independently recounted from decompressed fragment rows and reconcile exactly to the paired-multiome ATAC source counts.
fragment_count_linkage.mutation: A fragment file with a recomputed valid digest but one altered multiplicity must fail count linkage.

barcode_conflicts.rule: Duplicate/conflicting barcode identities must be detected before construction of any dict/map that could discard earlier rows.
barcode_conflicts.forbidden_pattern: dict(zip(...)) followed by a duplicate/conflict check over that dict

failure_receipts.rule: Fail-closed validation paths must emit a structured failure receipt. Uncaught exceptions are not acceptable qualification evidence.

consensus_blacklist.rule: A consensus peak universe is not authorized unless the frozen blacklist is supplied inside the consensus construction procedure. A no-blacklist consensus followed by post hoc filtering is not equivalent and must fail closed.

implemented_now: per-barcode multiplicity reconciliation to paired multiome
not_a_claim: This amendment does not claim the real Route-B consensus has been run.
This amendment does not replace the real Route-B authenticated 63.6 GB fragment receipt.
